title: Ada's Welcome Tea
story: Ada Quill edited the Gazette's puzzle page for forty-one years, and this morning she put the kettle on at the puzzle desk to welcome her new apprentice: you. Three neighbors dropped by to say hello, and each chose a different tea. "Your first assignment, partner, is to remember who drinks what," Ada says, handing you a sharp pencil. Who drank which tea?

texts: Teddy did not drink mint tea.
Lena drank neither mint nor chamomile tea.

trace.text: Lena must go with Earl Grey tea: clue 2 rules out mint tea and chamomile tea.
Teddy must go with chamomile tea: clue 1 rules out mint tea; Earl Grey tea already goes with Lena.
Una must go with mint tea: the other choices are already taken.
